rationale: A third party (the neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury on the policyholder's premises due to an icy walkway condition the policyholder was responsible for maintaining, which is a textbook premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Third-party claim: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on the policyholder's icy walkway during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bill recovery. High-priority pediatric injury claim requiring prompt investigation and reservation assessment.

case_facts.description: neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
